The '''bartender''' at [[Locru's Central Saloon]] was a grizzled [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He made no protest nor demand for reparations after [[Warto]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] started a bar fight.

==Behind the scenes==
This character can't be [[Locru]] himself, who was already dead by the time of the story.
